description: Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the 30-run baseline freezes. 'feedback' lists alerts to ask your human about (share answer_url, never answer it yourself).

key.description: Scoring key; omit when sent as x-kyde-key header.

name: get_scores

band.description: deviating (0-39) | watch (40-69) | normal (70-100); null while learning.

degraded.description: Present only when records were dropped today (quota/limits).

feedback.description: Alerts KYDE Score would like the human's verdict on. Ask your human in one sentence whether the alert was right and share answer_url. Never open or answer the link yourself: only the human's click counts.

title: Get drift scores
